Announcing dynamic content changes (toasts, inline validation summaries, loading/progress, cart/count changes) to assistive tech without moving focus. A status message communicates a state change the user should know about but that does not require a context change. Because focus does not move, the user needs another channel (a live region or role) for the change to be perceivable. Keep messages short and specific; avoid duplicate announcements; do not announce *and* move focus — pick one. If a UI/component library provides an announcement primitive, prefer it. 4. 5. ## Web implementation 6. 7. - Choose politeness by urgency: 8. - `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"` — success, progress, non-urgent updates. 9. - `role="alert"` / `aria-live="assertive"` — errors and time-sensitive warnings only. 10. - The live region element must exist in the DOM *before* content is inserted into it. Do not toggle `aria-live` on or off dynamically — create the region up front and mutate its text. 11. - don't combine `role="alert"` with `aria-live="assertive"` on the same element, and don't re-render identical text repeatedly. 12. 13. ### Choosing the right role 14. 15. | Situation | Use | 16. |---|---| 17. | Form submitted successfully | `role="status"` | 18. | Item added to cart / count updated | `role="status"` | 19. | Loading / "Saving..." | `role="status"` | 20. | Search results count updated | `role="status"` | 21. | Validation error summary rendered without focus move | `role="alert"` | 22. | Session about to expire | `role="alert"` | 23. | Destructive or time-critical warning | `role="alert"` | 24. 25. `role="status"` implies `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. `role="alert"` implies `aria-live="assertive"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Prefer the roles over raw `aria-live` attributes. 26. 27. ### Minimal patterns 28. 29. Polite status (persistent region, text updated on change): 30. 31. ```html 32.
33. ``` 34. 35. ```js 36. document.querySelector('[role="status"]').textContent = 'Message sent.'; 37. ``` 38. 39. Assertive alert for an inline error that does not move focus: 40. 41. ```html 42.
43. ``` 44. 45. Progress / loading: 46. 47. ```html 48.
49. 50. Loading results… 51.
52. ``` 53. 54. ### Common mistakes 55. 56. - **Inserting a new element with `role="status"` at the same time as its text.** Some AT will miss the announcement.
